changeSet.author: TDuric
changeSet.sql:
create or alter view [workflow].[ItemIssue] WITH SCHEMABINDING as select wi.id as WorkFlowItemId, cast(substring(issue_dv.displayvalue,0,850) as nvarchar(850)) as AssetName from [workflow].[type] wt inner join [workflow].[version] wv on (wt.id = wv.typeid) inner join [workflow].[item] wi on (wv.id = wi.versionid) inner join [dbo].[issue] iss on wi.[objectid] = iss.id and wi.[object] = 'Issue' inner join [dbo].[asset] cod on iss.objectid = cod.objectid and cod.[object] = iss.[object] inner join dbo.AssetDisplayValue issue_dv on issue_dv.assetid = cod.id go
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'CIX_WorkflowItemIssue') BEGIN CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX CIX_WorkflowItemIssue ON [workflow].[ItemIssue](WorkFlowItemId); END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_CIX_WorkflowItemIssue_AssetName') BEGIN CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX IX_CIX_WorkflowItemIssue_AssetName ON [workflow].[ItemIssue](AssetName); END
